name: Renedo de la Vega (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and green in the proportions 2:1:1, charged at the upper hoist with a white twelve-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Renedo de la Vega; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: twelve-pointed star at the upper hoist
